description: This file defines the MessagesCentral class responsible for managing and distributing log messages and firmware/UI panel messages within the application. It follows a singleton pattern, maintains a list of message listeners, and ensures thread-safe posting of messages via the Swing event dispatch thread.

classes.name: MessagesCentral
classes.description: Singleton class managing message listeners and propagating messages from firmware and UI panels.

classes.name: MessageListener
classes.description: Interface defining the callback for message events.

methods.name: MessagesCentral
methods.description: Private constructor initializing communication logging listener.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessagesCentral.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a message listener to the list.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to all registered listeners, logging the message and executing on the AWT event dispatch thread.
